title: mesh-bus-ingress-udp
description: UDP ingress plugin configuration and behavior.

target.description: fixed upstream host:port target for each datagram

socket_recv_buffer_bytes.description: Optional SO_RCVBUF size in bytes for the bound UDP ingress socket.

socket_send_buffer_bytes.description: Optional SO_SNDBUF size in bytes for the bound UDP ingress socket.

datagram_boundary.description: Each UDP socket recv_from is projected as exactly one DatagramSession::send_to call; payload boundaries are not parsed, coalesced, or split by this adapter.

session_model.description: Per-peer split data-path contract: first datagram from a peer opens a DatagramSession, splits it into send/recv halves, and spawns a response pump task. The main recv loop only calls send half; the pump task forwards egress responses back to the peer socket independently.
